description: Namur - Gares ferroviaires is a dataset listed in OpenData de la commune de Namur open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Localisation des gares ferroviaires sur la Commune de Namur. Coverage: Namur. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Transport, Gare, Chemin de fer, Train, Mobilité. The portal shows 8 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-06-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-namur-be-portal.
